queries:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(cnt) * 1.0 AS total, COUNT(*) * 1.0 AS n FROM c
)
SELECT c.observstation,
       c.cnt AS telescope_count,
       c.cnt / t.total AS share,
       c.cnt / t.total - 1.0 / t.n AS share_minus_avg
FROM c, t
WHERE c.cnt / t.total > 1.0 / t.n
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_telescopes FROM telescopes
),
n AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_obs FROM observatories
)
SELECT c.observstation,
       c.telescope_count,
       CAST(c.telescope_count AS REAL) / total.total_telescopes AS share,
       CAST(c.telescope_count AS REAL) / total.total_telescopes - 1.0 / n.num_obs AS share_minus_avg
FROM counts c, total, n
WHERE CAST(c.telescope_count AS REAL) / total.total_telescopes > 1.0 / n.num_obs
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation AS observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS cnt
  FROM observatories o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt,
         CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM counts
)
SELECT observstation, cnt AS telescope_count, share,
       share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS share_minus_avg
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
s AS (
  SELECT observstation, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM c
)
SELECT observstation, cnt AS telescope_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS share_minus_avg
FROM s
WHERE share >= (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)
ORDER BY share_minus_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;
